items.title: [HCM] Senior Fullstack Developer (Finance/Banking domain)
items.description:
**Thông tin vị trí**
Cấp bậc: Senior
Địa điểm: Quận Tân Bình TP. Hồ Chí Minh
Thời gian làm việc: Thứ Hai – Thứ Sáu, 08:30 – 17:30
—-------------------------------------------------------
**MÔ TẢ CÔNG VIỆC** 
- Tham gia phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế hệ thống và phát triển các tính năng cho hệ thống Tài chính/Cho vay (Finance/Lending).
- Phát triển ứng dụng backend bằng Java và frontend bằng Angular, đảm bảo sự tích hợp liền mạch giữa các thành phần của hệ thống.
- Thiết kế, phát triển và tối ưu hóa RESTful API; triển khai logic nghiệp vụ và tích hợp với các hệ thống liên quan.
- Làm việc với cơ sở dữ liệu Oracle/MS SQL Server, bao gồm viết truy vấn SQL, tối ưu hóa truy vấn và xử lý dữ liệu.
- Phối hợp với Business Analyst (BA), đội ngũ Đảm bảo chất lượng (QA) và các bên liên quan để hỗ trợ triển khai, kiểm thử và xử lý sự cố.

**YÊU CẦU BẮT BUỘC** 
**_Kỹ năng và kinh nghiệm chuyên môn_** 
- Tốt nghiệp Đại học/ Cao đẳng chuyên ngành IT
- Có 5+ năm kinh nghiệm phát triển phần mềm.
- Thành thạo phát triển backend bằng Java; ưu tiên có kinh nghiệm với Spring Boot, Spring Framework và Spring Security.
- Có kinh nghiệm phát triển frontend bằng Angular, TypeScript, HTML/CSS và tích hợp API.
- Có kinh nghiệm thiết kế, phát triển RESTful API, triển khai cơ chế xác thực và phân quyền (Authentication/Authorization), cũng như tích hợp hệ thống.
- Có kinh nghiệm thực tế với Oracle hoặc MS SQL Server, bao gồm viết câu lệnh SQL, thủ tục lưu trữ (Stored Procedures) và tối ưu hóa truy vấn.
- Có khả năng phân tích yêu cầu, thiết kế giải pháp kỹ thuật, thực hiện Code Review và chủ động giải quyết các vấn đề kỹ thuật độc lập.
**_Kiến thức về lĩnh vực Tài chính_** 
- Có kinh nghiệm tham gia các dự án thuộc lĩnh vực Tài chính/Ngân hàng.
- Hiểu biết về các quy trình nghiệp vụ tài chính cơ bản và xử lý dữ liệu giao dịch.
- Có khả năng đọc hiểu tài liệu kỹ thuật và yêu cầu nghiệp vụ bằng tiếng Anh.

items.title: GALAXY JOY - Data Engineer - 2 headcounts
items.description:
# 🚀 Hiring: Data Engineer | GalaxyJoy 

📍 **Location:** Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam  
🏢 **Department:** Technology  
👤 **Reporting to:** Senior Data Engineer  
💼 **Experience:** From 4 years

## About GalaxyJoy

GalaxyJoy is a member of the Galaxy Holdings Digital Ecosystem, working to build innovative loyalty solutions that connect customers, partners, and services through technology and data.

We are looking for a **Data Engineer II** to build reliable data pipelines, integrate diverse data sources, and optimize our cloud data platform to power analytics and data-driven decision-making.

## What You'll Do

- Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines to ingest data from S3, SFTP, SharePoint, email, and APIs.
- Develop and operate **Apache Airflow** workflows with reliable monitoring and failure alerting.
- Design and optimize data schemas, tables, and transformations in **Snowflake**.
- Manage data infrastructure using **Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi/Terraform)**.
- Integrate external data sources end-to-end, from ingestion and mapping to transformation and validation.
- Implement data quality checks to detect schema drift, missing data, and pipeline failures.
- Optimize pipeline and query performance as data volumes grow.
- Collaborate with Data Analysts, Backend Engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders.

## What We're Looking For

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
- 2–4 years of experience in Data Engineering or a related role.
- Strong **SQL** skills and proficiency in **Python, TypeScript**, or a similar language.
- Hands-on experience with cloud data warehouses such as **Snowflake, BigQuery, or Amazon Redshift**.
- Experience with **Apache Airflow** or equivalent workflow orchestration tools.
- Familiarity with **AWS (S3, IAM)** and cloud data architectures.
- Experience handling structured and semi-structured data (**CSV, JSON, Parquet**).
- Solid understanding of data modeling, incremental loading, and pipeline design patterns.
- Strong debugging, problem-solving, and ownership skills.

### Nice to Have
- Experience with **Pulumi, Terraform, or AWS CDK**.
- Experience integrating external data through SFTP, APIs, or file-based feeds.
- Familiarity with CI/CD, Git, and pull request reviews.

## 🎁 What We Offer

- Competitive salary package with performance-based bonuses.
- 100% of the official salary during probation.
- Comprehensive health and accident insurance.
- 15 days of annual leave per year.
- Work equipment provided: MacBook/laptop, monitor, mouse, and more.
- A modern, creative, and collaborative working environment.

## 📩 Apply Now

Ready to build reliable data pipelines and turn data into value?
Send your CV to **[talent@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:talent@galaxyjoy.vn)** or **[truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn)**.
**Subject:** Application – Data Engineer II – [Your Name]

items.title: GALAXY JOY - Middle/Senior Quality Control Engineer (Manual & Automation Testing) - 4 headcounts
items.description:
**Mission**
The QC Engineer is responsible for driving product quality and testing maturity across the team by owning end-to-end test strategies, building scalable automation frameworks for web, API, and mobile platforms, and mentoring junior engineers.

This role serves as a technical reference point and quality leader, ensuring that every release meets high standards of reliability, stability, and user trust. The QC Engineer works closely with Developers, BA, Product Owners, and DevOps to identify quality risks early, optimize test coverage, and continuously improve QA processes for fast and confident product delivery.

**I. Key Responsibilities**
- Define and own comprehensive test strategies, test plans, and test approaches for complex features and cross-platform initiatives, applying risk-based analysis to prioritize scope and optimize coverage.
- Design and execute complex test scenarios across functional, integration, regression, exploratory, and UAT testing for web, API, and mobile (Flutter) applications.
- Design, build, and maintain mobile automation frameworks for Flutter applications, covering cross-device and cross-OS scenarios (iOS & Android).
- Build and maintain scalable automation frameworks for Web UI and API testing using Playwright, Postman/Newman, or equivalent, including reusable components, utilities, and libraries.
- Lead API testing strategy across microservices and distributed systems, including authentication, schema validation, contract testing, and third-party integrations.
- Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and optimize execution time through parallelization and stable test design.
- Drive defect triage, root-cause analysis, and impact assessment for production issues, and contribute to release readiness assessments and Go/No-Go decisions.
- Mentor and coach junior/middle QC engineers through code reviews, knowledge-sharing sessions, and pair testing.
- Act as a quality advocate in cross-functional discussions with Dev, BA, PO, and stakeholders, and participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies.
- Champion adoption of ATDD/BDD/TDD practices and shift-left testing approaches; identify gaps in QA processes and implement scalable improvements.
- Support basic performance/load testing execution using tools such as K6, JMeter, or Locust when required.

**II. Requirements:**
- 3+ years of professional experience as a QC / Software Test Engineer, with proven track record of delivering quality across web, API, and mobile platforms in Agile/Scrum environments.
- Strong hands-on experience in manual testing, with deep expertise in test case design techniques (equivalence partitioning, boundary value analysis, decision tables, exploratory testing) and the ability to translate complex business requirements into comprehensive test scenarios.
- Strong hands-on experience with mobile automation testing, ideally for Flutter applications
- Solid understanding of mobile testing fundamentals: device fragmentation, OS versioning, gestures, push notifications, deep linking, offline behavior, and app lifecycle.
- Proven experience designing and building automation frameworks from scratch (not just maintaining existing ones), with strong knowledge of design patterns such as Page Object Model, Factory, Dependency Injection, and Data-Driven Testing.
- Proficient in modern API automation frameworks (Playwright API, Cypress API, Postman/Newman, RestAssured) and Web UI automation (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium WebDriver).
- Strong programming skills in JavaScript/TypeScript (preferred), Dart, Python, or Java.
- Extensive hands-on experience with API testing (Postman, Swagger, RESTful APIs, GraphQL), including authentication, error handling, schema validation, and contract testing across microservices and distributed systems.
- Strong experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines and proficient with Git and code review practices.
- Strong SQL skills for data validation, debugging, and root-cause analysis; comfortable analyzing application logs and backend behavior.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, strong communication and collaboration with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, mentoring mindset, and ownership mentality.
- Experience testing Flutter applications in production at scale.
- Experience in loyalty, fintech, banking, e-commerce, or e-wallet domains.
- Exposure to performance testing tools: K6, JMeter, Blazemeter, Locust.
- Experience with security testing (OWASP Top 10, JWT, OAuth, SQL injection, XSS).
- ISTQB Advanced Level or equivalent certifications.
- Good English communication skills (reading, writing, and speaking).

**III. Benefits:**
- Competitive salary package (Base salary and performance bonuses).
- Probation period salary is 100% of the official salary.
- Comprehensive health and accident insurance.
- 15 days of annual leave.
- Provision of work equipment (Macbook/Laptop, mouse, monitor, etc.).
- A creative and modern working environment.

**_Feel free to contact me if you need any assisstant or send your CV to mail: [talent@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:talent@galaxyjoy.vn)
[truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn](mailto:truchtm@galaxyjoy.vn)_**

items.description:
**I. Mô tả công việc/ Job Description:**

We’re building a scalable loyalty and fintech ecosystem that connects millions of users across Southeast Asia.

As a Backend Engineer, you will focus on hands-on backend development, owning backend services and modules end-to-end. This role emphasizes technical depth, system reliability, and code quality, without people-management responsibilities.

_1.1. Backend Development__

• Design, develop, and maintain high-performance backend services using Node.js.

• Build and evolve backendsystemsfollowing microservices or modular architecture.

• Develop RESTful APIs for web, mobile, andpartner integrations.

• Take end-to-end ownership of assigned backendservices or modules(design,

implementation, testing, deployment support).

• Optimize system performance, scalability, and reliability under high traffic.


_1.2. Code Quality & Operations_

• Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code.

• Participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards, security, and best practices.

• Debug and resolve complex backend issues in production environments.

• Proactively refactor code and reduce technical debt.

• Apply secure coding practices to protect systems and user data.


_1.3. Collaboration_

• Work closely with Frontend, Product, QA, and DevOps teams to deliver features on time.

• Analyze business requirements and propose appropriate technical solutions.

• Support release activities and ensure backend stability after deployment.


_1.4. Tools & Productivity_

• Use CI/ CD pipelines, logging, and monitoring tools effectively.

• Leverage AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve productivity when appropriate.

3+ years of hands-on experience with Node.js in production systems.

• Experience with event-driven architecture or message queues.

• Strong experience building backend services for high-traffic applications.

• Solid understanding of RESTful APIs, asynchronous processing, and backend performance optimization.

• Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases, caching (e.g., Redis).

• Good understanding of microservices and distributed systems concepts.

• Experience working with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, or Azure).

• Familiarity with Git and Agile/Scrum development processes.


_2.2. Mindset & Working Style_

• Strong ownership mindset over assigned services and components.

• Able to work independently with minimal supervision.

• Quality-focused, detail-oriented, and proactive in problem solving.

• Clear communication skills in a cross-functional team environment.

• No people management or team leadership responsibilities required.


_2.3. Bonus Skills:_

• Familiarity with event-driven architecture and message queues.

• Experience integrating third-party APIs or working in fintech / loyalty platforms.

• Contribution to open-source projects or technical communities.


_2.4. Nice to Have_

• Ability to analyze, review, and improve the complex legacy code.

• Experience integrating fintech, payment, loyalty, or third-party partner systems.

• Familiarity with monitoring and observability tools (ELK, Prometheus, Grafana).

items.description:
## 公司/团队介绍
我是猎头李越，我的客户以量化私募、国际对冲基金为主，覆盖北/上/深/港/新。
投递请联系微信号：liyue_1297 / 邮箱：liyue_1297@foxmail.com；但看不看机会都欢迎认识~

这家公司是专注于加密衍生品和交易基础设施的金融科技公司。
岗位主要负责加密货币衍生品市场中的自动化交易策略开发和维护，参与实时、低延迟交易系统建设。将和交易员、量化研究员、基础设施工程师一起优化报价逻辑、交易执行、风险控制和系统稳定性。
年限20年以上也乐于接受，但是要求至少2年Rust经验。

## 薪资福利待遇
薪资不设限制，根据各人情况给涨幅。

## 地点
香港

## 工作性质
全职，香港线下，不能远程
  
## 岗位要求、职责
投递请联系微信号：liyue_1297 / 邮箱：liyue_1297@foxmail.com
 
主要职责：
1. 开发和维护自动化交易策略及相关交易系统。
2. 参与报价逻辑、对冲逻辑、仓位管理和风险控制的开发。
3. 优化交易系统的下单、撤单、成交处理和异常处理流程。
4. 处理实时行情数据、订单簿数据、成交数据、资金费率等交易相关数据。
5. 建设和维护监控工具，包括 PnL、仓位、风险、延迟、交易所连接状态等。
6. 协助交易员和量化研究员分析策略表现，发现问题并持续优化。
7. 维护交易所 API 连接，保证行情、下单、成交回报等流程稳定可靠。
8. 排查交易异常、系统异常、仓位偏差和风控问题。
 
任职要求：
1. 熟练掌握 Rust，在Rust的基础上熟悉C++更好
2. 有自动化交易、做市、量化交易或交易系统开发经验。
3. 理解订单簿、买卖价差、滑点、手续费、成交、撤单和仓位风险等基本概念。
4. 熟悉加密货币交易所、永续合约、资金费率、保证金等机制。
5. 能写出稳定、清晰、可维护的代码。
6. 具备较强的问题排查能力，能快速定位线上系统或交易异常。
7. 对交易和市场有兴趣，愿意理解策略为什么赚钱或亏钱。
8. 有责任心，能在快节奏环境中推进事情落地。

加分项：
1. 有加密货币做市、HFT、自营交易或量化交易经验。
2. 熟悉Binance、OKX、Bybit、Deribit、Coinbase等交易所 API。
3. 有低延迟交易系统开发经验。
4. 了解基差交易、统计套利、跨交易所交易、对冲或风控系统。
5. 有回测系统、交易模拟、数据分析或策略研究经验。
6. 获得过ACM奖牌等奖项。
7. 优秀的Github项目。

我的微信号是：liyue_1297，看不看机会都欢迎认识！

items.title: [Híbrido / São Paulo, Brasil] Engenheiro de Software Backend Sênior (Híbrido, São Paulo) na Coodesh
items.description:
## Descrição da vaga: Esta é uma vaga de um parceiro da plataforma Coodesh, ao candidatar-se você terá acesso as informações completas sobre a empresa e benefícios. Fique atento ao redirecionamento que vai te levar para uma url [https://coodesh.com](https://coodesh.com/jobs/engenharia-de-software-backend-senior-hibrido-sao-paulo-231806636?utm_source=github&utm_medium=backend-br-vagas&modal=open) para realizar a candidatura. 👋 Empresas parceiras da Coodesh, de scale-ups a grandes companhias de tecnologia, estão buscando pessoas engenheiras de backend para construir sistemas que atendem milhões de usuários. Você vai trabalhar em times de produto com autonomia técnica, código revisado por pares e decisões guiadas por dados.   ### O que você vai fazer * Projetar, desenvolver e manter serviços e APIs com foco em escalabilidade, confiabilidade e segurança. * Participar de decisões de arquitetura e de design de sistemas distribuídos. * Escrever testes automatizados e revisar código de outras pessoas do time. * Investigar e resolver problemas em produção, usando métricas, logs e rastreamento. * Colaborar com produto, design e outras engenharias para entregar valor de forma incremental.   ### Como funciona pela Coodesh 1. Crie sua conta e complete seu perfil com LinkedIn ou currículo. 2. Faça o Assessment da vaga 3. Com o perfil validado por assessment, uma pessoa especialista Coodesh vai fazer uma verificação. A pessoa especialista apresenta a você aos processos de empresas parceiras que combinam com o seu perfil.   ### Seu Assessment * Até 30 minutos, em dois blocos: * Julgar e Escolher * Planejar e Fazer A avaliação tem recursos de integridade/proctoring. * Assessment com nota superior a 70% gera certificado com validade de 1 ano. ## Coodesh Experts: Crie seu perfil, mostre o que você sabe fazer em uma avaliação de até 30 minutos e conte com um especialista da Coodesh para chegar às empresas que estão contratando.

items.title: [Bug]: schema-invalid jobs index prevents fallback to a healthy jobs.json
items.description:
### Bug Type
Portal: website not loading or showing stale data

### Description
The browser's fallback from `jobs-index.json` to `jobs.json` handles HTTP / JSON-decoding failures, but not a successful JSON response with an invalid jobs schema. If the index answers HTTP 200 with `{ "nope": 1 }` while `jobs.json` contains valid postings, `loadJobs` returns an error and zero jobs without requesting the healthy full dataset.

Verified against `main` at `c73256709`; the relevant files are unchanged from that commit. This is a deterministic fault-injection reproduction, not evidence that production currently serves an invalid index.

### Steps to Reproduce
Run from the repository root:

```sh
node --input-type=module <<'JS'
import { loadJobs } from './site/src/data/jobs-source.js';
const calls = [];
const fetchImpl = async (url) => {
  calls.push(url);
  return {
    ok: true,
    json: async () => url.endsWith('jobs-index.json')
      ? { nope: 1 }
      : { jobs: [{ job_id: 'job_valid', title: 'Junior Engineer', company: 'Example' }] },
  };
};
const result = await loadJobs(fetchImpl, false);
console.log({ calls, jobs: result.jobs.length, error: result.error });
JS
```

Actual:

```text
calls: ['./jobs-index.json']
jobs: 0
error: 'jobs payload has no "jobs" array'
```

Expected: `jobs.json` is requested, its valid posting is returned, and `error` is null.

### Cause
In [`jobs-source.js`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/data/jobs-source.js), the inner `try/catch` protects only the index fetch/decode. `normalizeJobsPayload(payload)` runs after that catch, so a schema error goes straight to the outer failure handler and bypasses the fallback.

The existing “reports a malformed payload” test supplies only an invalid index. It does not provide a healthy full file or assert that fallback was attempted.

### Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Index loading is considered successful only after schema validation and normalization succeed.
- [ ] A schema-invalid index triggers a request for `jobs.json`.
- [ ] A valid full payload restores jobs and returns `error: null`.
- [ ] A valid empty index (`jobs: []`) remains a successful empty result, without fallback.
- [ ] When both candidates fail, the loader resolves with an explicit error rather than rejecting or silently reporting success.
- [ ] Add deterministic tests for invalid index + healthy full payload, both invalid, and valid empty index; cover schema-invalid Brotli index payloads as applicable.

### Validation
Reproduced with the injected fetch above. Existing checks also pass: `vitest run src/lib/share.test.js src/data/data-sources.test.js test/seo.test.js` (**50 passed**).

Searched open and closed issues for index/fallback/malformed-payload reports; no issue tracking this specific jobs-loader recovery gap was found.

items.title: [Bug]: near-miss job share links point to static pages that are never generated
items.description:
### Bug Type
Portal: broken link or incorrect data displayed

### Description
“Copy link to this job” produces a static `/job/<job_id>/` URL for a near-miss posting, even though the SEO build generates these pages only for the curated dataset. The copied link therefore points to a page the deployment does not contain.

Verified against `main` at `c73256709`. The relevant source and fixture files are unchanged from that commit. This is reproduced locally using committed fixtures; no live posting counts are asserted.

### Steps to Reproduce
1. Build the fixture site (`cd site && npm run build:fixtures`).
2. Open the board and enable **WIDEN SCOPE → internships & co-ops**.
3. Select the fixture posting `job_e001ffffffffffffffff` (Palantir, Software Engineer Intern - Summer 2027).
4. Click “Copy link to this job”. The URL is `https://jobs.riteshrana.engineer/job/job_e001ffffffffffffffff/` (or the equivalent preview origin).
5. Inspect `site/dist/job/job_e001ffffffffffffffff/index.html`: it does not exist. Opening the copied URL cannot restore that posting.

Independent local verification called `generateSeo` directly on `site/test/fixtures`: it generated 19 curated job pages, while the page for this near-miss ID was absent. Calling `jobShareUrl(mapJob(nearMiss), location)` returned the missing static-page URL.

### Cause
- [`share.js`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/lib/share.js) selects the static path for every valid `jobId`, without considering `nearMiss`.
- [`DashboardView.jsx`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/src/components/hiring/DashboardView.jsx) uses that helper for both curated and widened-scope rows.
- [`generate.mjs`](https://github.com/ambicuity/New-Grad-Jobs/blob/c73256709/site/scripts/seo/generate.mjs) reads `jobs.json` / `jobs-index.json`, not `jobs-extended.json`.

### Expected Behavior / Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Copied links for near misses open the board with the selected posting restored.
- [ ] The link includes every required `include` reason so the receiving browser loads the extended dataset and can display the posting, including postings with multiple reasons.
- [ ] Curated postings retain their existing static job-page links.
- [ ] Links work at the domain root and under a GitHub Pages subpath.
- [ ] Curated counts, feeds, and SEO job-page scope remain unchanged.
- [ ] Add deterministic unit coverage plus an integration/E2E case that opens a copied near-miss link in a fresh view.

### Validation and Related Issues
`vitest run src/lib/share.test.js src/data/data-sources.test.js test/seo.test.js`: **50 passed**. The gap is not exercised by those tests.

Related to #181, but distinct: the current React detail view and URL state already exist. This report concerns the wrong destination produced by the current share action specifically for the near-miss tier.

items.title: [Product Bug] Jobs auto-detected as "Applied" remain visible in "Liked" tab (cross-tab duplication)
items.description:
Hi Jobright team. Filing here because this repo is the most public-visible surface; please route to the extension / web-app product team.

### Bug

After the Chrome extension auto-detects a submitted application, the job stays in **both** the "Liked" tab AND the "Applied" tab. User has to manually un-Like each one or Liked-tab counts inflate indefinitely.

### Repro

1. Save a job to the Liked list (click heart/save on a job card)
2. Apply to that same job on the external careers page
3. Return to Jobright dashboard
4. Observe: job appears in both Applied AND Liked

### Expected

Once auto-detect flips a job to Applied, it should disappear from Liked. "Applied" supersedes "Liked" in the user's pipeline model: you don't "like" a job you've already committed to.

### Impact

Breaks pipeline tracking integrity. Any user with 20+ liked jobs who applies to a few per day accumulates a growing phantom Liked list that no longer reflects pipeline state. Appears to be a recurring class of complaint in third-party Jobright reviews (weak submission tracking).

### One-click diagnostic for your eng team

Hard-refresh the Liked tab after reproducing:

- **Duplicate persists**: backend data model issue (likely independent `isLiked` + `isApplied` boolean flags with no mutex, or separate collections with no cross-delete on apply-event)
- **Duplicate clears**: frontend cache-invalidation miss on apply-event (likely Chrome extension writes applied status without invalidating the Liked-list query)

### Fix sketch

- **Write-side**: on apply-event, set `isLiked=false` as well, OR migrate to a single `status` enum (liked / applied / interviewing / rejected) that is mutually exclusive
- **Query-side (belt-and-suspenders)**: filter Liked by `isLiked AND status != 'applied' AND status != 'interviewing'` so the bug cannot recur via other write paths

### Severity

**High**. Not critical (no data loss, no security issue), but breaks the extension's core value prop of trustworthy pipeline tracking. 200K users times this friction = material NPS impact.

Happy to provide screenshots if that unblocks routing.
